newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivorian cocoa crop tops one mln tonnes by May 4.
newsitem.headline: Ivorian cocoa crop tops one mln tonnes by May 4.

text.p: Declared arrivals of Ivory Coast's 1996/97 (October-September) cocoa crop totalled 1.015 million tonnes by May 4, industry sources said.
The figure, which includes the 1996/97 main crop (October-April) plus the first four days of the smaller mid-crop (May-September), was just under 1.045 million by April 30 last year.
A comparative figure for May 4, 1996 was not available.
Ivory Coast produced a record 1.2 million tonnes crop in 1995/96 including a bumper 200,000 tonnes mid-crop.
Private crop analysts told Reuters they expect a 1996/97 mid-crop of 160,000-180,000 tonnes, depending on rains into June.
Ivory Coast has not adjusted its official total 1996/97 crop forecast of 950,000 tonnes.
